title: Dispatch by a tag and a function table
description: You can compare choosing a switch branch with calling a function stored in a table.

steps.description: Shape records a kind and size. area selects the corresponding formula with a switch.
TABLE pairs operation names with function pointers. Both functions accept and return a double.
main constructs a square of size 3 and prints its area. The loop searches the table for the name square.

steps.question: Which function receives 5 when the table name matches square?
steps.answer: The stored pointer calls square, returning 25.

steps.description: The supplied output displays area: 9 and square(5) = 25. The table entry supplies the second calculation's function.
